title: Graph diffusion transformer for interpretable generation and inverse design of disordered atomic structures
abstract: arXiv:2611.18420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Atomic disorder offers a potent degree of freedom to tailor material properties, yet the resulting vast configuration space obscures structure-property relations and hinders rational inverse design. Here we introduce Graph Amorphous Diffusion Transformer (GaDiT), a generative model that combines dynamic periodic graphs, masked conditioning and an interval-weighted training-noise distribution. GaDiT generates high-quality disordered structures while accelerating sampling by two orders of magnitude compared with existing corrector-based approaches, as demonstrated across two-dimensional amorphous carbon and three-dimensional amorphous silicon and silica. Moreover, GaDiT supports conditional generation under single or combined structural features, physical properties and preparation conditions in a unified model, and enables inverse design that expands accessible structure-property ranges beyond the training distribution. translated_title: 用于无序原子结构可解释生成与逆向设计的图扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 原子无序性为调控材料性能提供了一个强有力的自由度，但由此产生的庞大构型空间掩盖了结构-性能关系，阻碍了理性的逆向设计。在此，我们提出了图无序扩散Transformer（GaDiT），这是一种结合了动态周期图、掩码条件化和区间加权训练噪声分布的生成模型。GaDiT能够生成高质量的无序结构，同时与现有的基于校正器的方法相比，将采样速度提升两个数量级，这一点在二维非晶碳以及三维非晶硅和二氧化硅上得到了验证。此外，GaDiT在统一模型中支持基于单一或组合的结构特征、物理性质和制备条件的条件生成，并实现了将可及的结构-性能范围扩展至训练分布之外的逆向设计。
tldr: 提出GaDiT图扩散Transformer生成模型，通过动态周期图、掩码条件化与区间加权噪声分布，实现无序原子结构的高质量生成、采样速度提升两个数量级，并支持统一模型下的多条件生成与逆向设计。
en_tdlr: We introduce GaDiT, a graph diffusion transformer combining dynamic periodic graphs, masked conditioning and interval-weighted training-noise distribution, which generates high-quality disordered atomic structures with two-orders-of-magnitude faster sampling and enables unified conditional generation and inverse design beyond the training distribution.
